ensemble.rule: Validation-selected weights replace equal weights only if they beat them by >= 0.005 OOF PR-AUC, the gain also holds on a split-half check, and they are a real blend (no member has weight >= 0.9). Otherwise the ensemble uses equal weights.

tuned_variant_test.note: Reported for transparency only; these weights were chosen on training data and are not deployed unless they pass the rule above.

selection.basis: Cross-validated (out-of-fold, calibrated) PR-AUC on the training split; models within 0.01 PR-AUC of the best are separated by Brier score, then by simplicity. The test set is not used.

never_fails.label: Always predict 'no failure'
never_fails.note: High accuracy, but it never finds a failure.

rule_based.label: All documented failure rules (HDF, PWF, OSF, tool wear >= 200 min)
rule_based.note: No machine learning. Tool wear >= 200 min is common, so this flags many healthy machines (low precision).

rule_physical.label: Documented rules without tool wear (HDF, PWF, OSF only)
rule_physical.note: No machine learning. Shows how much of the target is a fixed rule in this synthetic dataset.

evaluation.note: Test-set figures are descriptive: each type has few failures in the test set (see counts), so they carry wide uncertainty. Threshold comparisons use cross-validation on the training split only.
